record.verdict: All eight complete Mame Latin bodies and declared source-owned turns support the specified 1962 targets under the declared word-exact normalization rule. The sole locator-note error found was corrected in immutable v2; no body or turn change was required.

rights_and_extent.basis: The source-selected words are fully present in the registered Mame 1922 witness; the normalized artifact derives directly from that public-domain source and contains no 1962-only prayer addition. Read the exact whole-PDF title page: Tours, Alfred Mame, editio quarta, MCMXXII. The bounded Ordinary pages have continuous printed pagination and matching book typography; no later insert is evidenced in these selected extents. Registered publication-term/mechanical-reproduction basis remains the basis, not host availability.

record.word_exact_qualification: Word-exact is the existing comparison category permitting declared accents/ligatures, j/i, capitalization, pointing and crosses, including negligentiis/neglegentiis and eumdem/eundem. It is not a claim that the Mame string is byte-identical to the 1962 print.
record.canonical_preimage_status: All declared canonical owner preimage bytes, old artifact/payload hashes and removed owner-provenance literals matched at review. The exact prepared owner was reconstructed in memory from the patch. No canonical file was written.
scope_exclusions: Parser/runtime design and guard implementation are assigned to a separate independent reviewer. Author test results are pinned but not substituted for this source review.
Root owns admission and the separate existing-positive source_epoch exceptions.
No English selection, target frame, remaining sixteen qualifications, or old Cummiskey printed-source correction is approved.
